{{Short description|none}}
This is a list of [[ultra prominent peak]]s (with [[topographic prominence]] greater than 1,500 metres) in the [[Malay Archipelago]], a group of over 25,000 [[island]]s which includes [[Brunei]], [[Singapore]], [[East Malaysia]], [[Indonesia]], the [[Philippines]] and [[East Timor]]. However, this list excludes ultras in the [[Philippines]] which are listed separately.
